paper_title: On the Consistency of Naive Set Theories over Substructural and Fuzzy Logics
statement: Let us conclude by restating the main open problem: is Cantor-Łukasiewicz set theory Łset consistent?
context: When defining Ł− set , our approach is to restrict logic, in contrast to prior work [30, 2, 11] which restrict comprehension. We believe that our approach is closer to the original type-free approach of Church [3]. Let us conclude by restating the main open problem: is Cantor-Łukasiewicz set theory Łset consistent?
